object_description: linear five-story school volume with central access cores
design_condition: The linear volume follows the river and street, creating a compact footprint and generous open spaces on all sides that connect to the surrounding landscaped park.

positive.statement: The linear five-story volume responds consistently to the river and street as location-defining linear elements.

position.rationale: Elongated five-story mass is clearly visible, extending along the site with repeated horizontal floor bands.

positive.statement: The compact design generates a small footprint and generous open spaces on all sides.

position.rationale: Narrow elongated footprint leaves substantial open area around the sampled building perimeter.

positive.statement: The campus concept creates an exciting structural dialogue among the three volumes.

position.rationale: Overall massing is visible, while separate campus volumes are not distinctly isolated in the exterior sample.

positive.statement: The spacious hall, gallery-like mezzanine, and central classroom hall provide differentiated horizontal connections.

position.target: spacious hall and central classroom hall
position.rationale: Interior connection zones are approximated within the central portion of the elongated sampled volume.

positive.statement: The punctual core insertions develop a good internal scale.

position.rationale: Repeated internal interruptions suggest central access cores distributed through the linear building.

positive.statement: A rational and disciplined construction grid enables a high level of flexibility.

position.rationale: Regular repeated point rows across elevations indicate a disciplined serial structural grid.

positive.statement: The simple structure and serially used elements suggest high cost-effectiveness.

position.rationale: Repeated construction elements are visible throughout the building envelope.

positive.statement: Routes and path connections are generally convincing.

position.rationale: Approach and landscape routes are approximated along the building’s open southern surroundings.

positive.statement: The greater opening of classrooms to the central zone develops a good cross-relationship.

position.rationale: Central classroom relationship is approximated within the middle of the sampled linear plan.

negative.statement: The appropriateness of the bridge-like construction over the ground-floor zone is questioned, as is its exaggerated facade counterpart.

position.rationale: Lower-level separation and bridge-like continuity are visible in the elevation point bands.

negative.statement: The passage widths between the classroom wall and the air space appear too small.

position.rationale: Passage locations are approximated beside the long classroom-facing edges.

negative.statement: The positioning of the kitchen, serving kitchen, and cafeteria on different levels is called into question.

position.rationale: Service and cafeteria spaces are not distinguishable; approximate mid-lower interior placement is used.

negative.statement: The side entrances do not provide enough address on the street side and should be easier to recognize.

position.rationale: Side access is assigned to the west-facing long edge near ground level.

negative.statement: The outdoor-space concept provides too few paved areas for differentiated stays, festivals, and events.

position.rationale: Open ground around the footprint is visible, especially along the eastern side.

negative.statement: The ambitious outdoor-space concept may be too detour-focused, complicated, and maintenance-intensive for its task.

position.rationale: Distributed open areas around the long footprint provide the landscape anchor.

negative.statement: The revised cores narrow the passageways and reduce flexibility and spaciousness.

position.rationale: Repeated core-like interruptions appear within the building’s central structure.

negative.statement: The additional similar cores reduce good orientation inside.

position.rationale: Multiple repeated internal elements are distributed along the elongated plan.

negative.statement: The auditorium-related room group and the mezzanine media library lack convincing organization and vertical connection.

position.target: auditorium room group and mezzanine media library
position.rationale: Specialized interior rooms are approximated in the lower-central portion of the volume.

negative.statement: The demonstrated flexibility appears more like an illusion and is not convincing in everyday use or detail.

position.rationale: Judgment concerns operational performance of flexibility rather than a specific model location.

negative.statement: The revised facade seems bulky and obscures the internal logic and constructive idea.

position.rationale: Bulky repeated facade bands are clearly visible along the long exterior elevations.

negative.statement: The outdoor-space criticisms were not addressed, and the bridge still appears somewhat artificial.

position.rationale: Ground-level bridge-like edge and adjacent open space are approximated at the southern end.
